=SUM( SELECT( Loans[30D Principal Days], [Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID] ) )
=SUM( SELECT( Repayments[30D Principal Reduction Days], [Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID] ) )
=( [30D Gross Principal Days] - [30D Principal Reduction Days] ) / 30
=IF( [30D Average Outstanding Principal] > 0, [Profit Last 30 Days] / [30D Average Outstanding Principal], 0 )

=IFS( COUNT([Todays Collection Charges]) = 0, "", COUNT( SELECT( Charges[Row ID], AND( IN([Row ID], [_THISROW].[Todays Collection Charges]), [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Payment Status] <> "ชำระแล้ว" ) ) ) > 0, "Overdue", AND( NOT(IN("รอชำระ", [Todays Collection Charges][Payment Status])), NOT(IN("ชำระบางส่วน", [Todays Collection Charges][Payment Status])) ), "Fully Paid", OR( IN("ชำระบางส่วน", [Todays Collection Charges][Payment Status]), AND( IN("ชำระแล้ว", [Todays Collection Charges][Payment Status]), IN("รอชำระ", [Todays Collection Charges][Payment Status]) ) ), "Partially Paid", TRUE, "Not Paid")

=SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], OR(AND([Payment Status] <> "ชำระแล้ว", [Charge Date] <= TODAY()), AND([Payment Status] = "ชำระแล้ว", [Payment Date] = TODAY()), IN(TODAY(), [Related Repayments][Payment Date]))))
=SUM(SELECT(Repayments[Amount Received], AND(IN([Ref Charges], [_THISROW].[Todays Collection Charges]), [Payment Date] = TODAY())))
=IF( SUM(Borrowers[Total Outstanding Principal]) = 0, 0, [Total Outstanding Principal] / SUM(Borrowers[Total Outstanding Principal]) )
=COUNT( SELECT( Loans[Row ID], AND([Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Loan Status] = "ยังไม่ปิดยอด") ) )
=MAX( SELECT( Loans[Loan Age Days], AND([Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Loan Status] = "ยังไม่ปิดยอด") ) )
=SUM( SELECT( Charges[Amount Remaining], AND( [Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Payment Status] <> "ชำระแล้ว" ) ) )
=COUNT( SELECT( Charges[Row ID], AND( [Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Payment Status] <> "ชำระแล้ว" ) ) )
=COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] < TODAY())))
=COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Historical On Time] = TRUE)))
=IF([Historical Charge Count] = 0, 0, [On Time Charge Count] / [Historical Charge Count])
=COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 30, [Charge Date] < TODAY())))
=COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 30, [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Historical On Time] = TRUE)))
=IF([Recent 30D Charge Count] = 0, 0, [Recent 30D On Time Count] / [Recent 30D Charge Count])
=COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Historical Late] = TRUE)))
=COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 30, [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Historical Late] = TRUE)))
=MAX(SELECT(Charges[Charge Date], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Days Late] > 0)))
=MAX(LIST(0) + SELECT(Loans[Principal Amount], AND([Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Loan Status] = "ปิดยอดแล้ว", [Defaulted] = FALSE)))

=IF(COUNT(SELECT(Loans[Row ID], AND([Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Loan Status] = "ปิดยอดแล้ว", [Defaulted] = FALSE))) = 0, 0, AVERAGE(SELECT(Loans[Principal Amount], AND([Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Loan Status] = "ปิดยอดแล้ว", [Defaulted] = FALSE))))
=SUM(SELECT(Loans[Default Loss Amount], AND([Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Defaulted] = TRUE)))

="ส่วนแบ่งของผู้กู้ใน KPI กำไรคาดการณ์สิ้นเดือน: ดอกเบี้ยที่รับแล้วเดือนนี้ + ดอกเบี้ยคงเหลือในรายการเรียกเก็บ + ดอกเบี้ยคาดการณ์ที่เหลือ / Borrower contribution to Projected Monthly Profit: realized interest MTD + open-charge interest remaining + forecast remaining interest."
="ส่วนแบ่งกำไรคาดการณ์สิ้นเดือน / Projected Monthly Profit Contribution"

=SUM(SELECT(Repayments[Interest Paid], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], MONTH([Payment Date]) = MONTH(TODAY()), YEAR([Payment Date]) = YEAR(TODAY())))) + SUM(SELECT(Charges[Interest Remaining], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] <= TODAY()))) + SUM(SELECT(Loans[Expected Interest This Month], [Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID]))
=IF([Matrix Active Borrower Count] > 0, 1 / [Matrix Active Borrower Count], "")
=IF( SUM(SELECT(Borrowers[Profit Last 10 Days], [Has Active Loan] = TRUE)) > 0, [Profit Last 10 Days] / SUM(SELECT(Borrowers[Profit Last 10 Days], [Has Active Loan] = TRUE)), "" )
=IF([Recent 30D Charge Count] = 0, "", 100 * [Recent 30D On Time Count] / [Recent 30D Charge Count])

=IF(COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 180, [Charge Date] < TODAY()))) = 0, "", 100 * COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 180, [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Historical On Time] = TRUE))) / COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 180, [Charge Date] < TODAY()))))

=IF(COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 90, [Charge Date] < TODAY()))) = 0, "", IFS(COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 90, [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Ref Loans].[Defaulted] = TRUE))) > 0, 0, MAX(LIST(0) + SELECT(Charges[Days Late], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 90, [Charge Date] < TODAY()))) = 0, 100, MAX(LIST(0) + SELECT(Charges[Days Late], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 90, [Charge Date] < TODAY()))) <= 1, 90, MAX(LIST(0) + SELECT(Charges[Days Late], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 90, [Charge Date] < TODAY()))) <= 3, 70, MAX(LIST(0) + SELECT(Charges[Days Late], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] >= TODAY() - 90, [Charge Date] < TODAY()))) <= 7, 40, TRUE, 10))

=IFS(COUNT(SELECT(Loans[Row ID], AND([Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Defaulted] = TRUE, [Outstanding Principal] > 0))) > 0, 0, COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Amount Remaining] > 0, [Days Late] > 3))) > 0, 20, COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Amount Remaining] > 0, [Days Late] >= 2))) > 0, 40, COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] < TODAY(), [Amount Remaining] > 0, [Days Late] >= 1))) > 0, 60, COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] = TODAY(), [Amount Remaining] > 0, [Total Paid] > 0))) > 0, 75, COUNT(SELECT(Charges[Row ID], AND([Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] = TODAY(), [Amount Remaining] > 0))) > 0, 90, TRUE, 100)
=FLOOR( TOTALHOURS( TODAY() - MIN( SELECT( Charges[Charge Date], AND( [Ref Loans].[Ref Borrowers] = [_THISROW].[Row ID], [Charge Date] < TODAY() ) ) ) ) / 24 ) >= 3
